items.t: Calexico LPOE Gantry Roof Repair
items.d: In accordance with FAR 5.101(b)(1)(i), this is a 15 day presolicitation notice that GSA will solicit contractors to install new Tremco AlphaGuard system or approved equivalent on the Gantry Building at the Calexico East Land Port of Entry (CA0540WW) in Calexico, CA. The work encompasses surface preparation, substrate repairs, flashing details, joint sealing, priming, and the application of a high-performance, two-component, bio-based polyurethane liquid-applied roof system (Tremco AlphaGuardTM BIO System) reinforced with stitchbonded polyester fabric (Tremco Permafab®). The primary purpose of this project is to restore waterproofing integrity, address seam and detail vulnerabilities, enhance solar reflectance, and extend the service life of the roof system without requiring a costly tear-off, while minimizing VOC emissions and odors during construction in an occupied federal facility.

items.t: Hanscom’s Execution & Rapid Operations (HERO)- Industry Day
items.d: Join the Department of the Air Force and the 66th Air Base Group (66 ABG) at the Hanscom Conference Center for an interactive HERO (Hanscom’s Execution & Rapid Operations) Industry Day. This event is designed specifically to help local and regional commercial construction groups navigate 10 U.S.C. § 2808a, a new, flexible statutory authority for military facility construction and repair that operates entirely outside standard Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) rules. We will preview the FY27 Hanscom AFB construction and renovation pipeline—featuring 9 upcoming projects valued between $2.5M and $50M—and discuss streamlined, commercial-style delivery methods like Progressive Design-Build (PDB) and Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) pricing. Please review the following event details: Date: Monday, December 14, 2026 Location: Hanscom Conference Center, B1106, 25 Grenier St., Hanscom AFB, MA 01

items.t: Synthetic Precipitation Capability (Oceanic and Offshore)
items.d: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) relies on a land-based network of Next Generation Weather Radars (NEXRAD) to detect precipitation intensity and movement, delivering real-time weather mosaics directly to air traffic controllers’ displays. While land-based radar coverage is continuous across the contiguous United States (CONUS), radar performance degrades significantly in offshore and oceanic airspace. Beyond 124 nautical miles (nm), radar accuracy diminishes due to signal attenuation and beam broadening, and Earth’s curvature elevates the radar beam above low-altitude precipitation (missing weather below 10,000 feet at 124 nm and below 40,000 feet at 248 nm). Beyond 248 nm, ground-based radar coverage ceases entirely. items.d: The site visit will be held on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Standard Time (EST). Quoters who do not attend the mandatory site visit will be non-responsive offerors. USDA requires a Design/Build contractor to complete the rehabilitation of Parking Lot 9 at the Jamie L. Whitten Building in Washington, DC. The project includes perimeter security upgrades, parking lot resurfacing, sinkhole remediation, electrical work, and landscaping, and is a key component of a larger effort to establish Level IV security protection around the facility. The contractor must assess and update incomplete 2021 construction documents, verify the suitability of security materials already stored on site, and coordinate closely with WMATA due to the Orange, Blue, and Silver Metro lines running beneath the parking lot. Culverts installed during original road construction in the mid-1990s and during subsequent upgrades are inadequate to allow unobstructed stream flow and sediment transport downstream. items.t: Lower Brule North Shoreline Stabilization And Ecosystem Restoration, Element 2
items.d: The project is located along the right descending bank of Lake Sharpe near the Lower Brule, SD town site. Lower Brule North Element 2 includes a 100-foot-wide riparian planting bench, a gravel maintenance path along the entire reach, a riprap revetment to protect the shoreline and island from erosion, and the creation of a 200-by-1,500-foot island constructed in water up to three feet deep. The sheltered open water area between the island and the shoreline will develop into approximately 5.17 acres of emergent wetland, and this will also create approximately 32 acres of riparian habitat. Related tasks include earth moving, grading, bank shaping, rock installation, water management, fill, and topsoil placement.

items.t: SNPLMA Kalamazoo Fence
items.d: This intent of this project is to construct approximately 0.5 miles of barbwire fence lines near Kalamazoo Campground on the Ely Ranger District. Construct two barbwire drift fences totaling approximately 0.5 miles in length to exclude active grazing within Kalamazoo Campground. Livestock in the campground presents a safety hazard and has resulted in numerous complaints from the public. In addition, limiting livestock activities within the campground will also extend protection of newly installed recreational infrastructure. This project includes construction of approximately 2,500 feet of new barbwire fence including installation of an estimated four 12-foot wire gates as a lump sum.

items.t: Rosebud Lift Station Construction
items.d: The existing lift station has been in place since the early 1990s. Since its creation the hospital anticipates increased expansion in the emergency department, added on Tribal programs (dialysis, detox, Tribal Health Administration Building), added on 19 more quarters units, and is anticipating adding an additional 23 quarters units. The existing pumps are facing replacement every 1-2 years due to the unanticipated growth, but due to the growth we need to consider increasing the capacity of the wet well. In addition to switching from standard submersible pumps to chopper pumps to accommodate the random objects that get flushed into the system. In July both pumps ended up failing and they had to not only replace the pumps but pay for sewage disposal to circumvent overflow. A separate project is in the works to begin remediating/replacing damaged sewer mains due to inflow and infiltration.
